4 hours later...
#Annalie.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Uff…
Lady Annalie: That was a lot of work, but I’m starting to see some progress.
You: Yeah… {{wi}}To be honest I don’t remember last time I worked this hard…
Lady Annalie: Sorry for taking advantage of you like that…
You: Don’t worry! I’m glad I could help!
Lady Annalie: It’s getting late, you should probably go back.
You: I can still work!
Lady Annalie: You helped enough! Besides, you wouldn’t want to worry your girlfriend, right?
You: Maybe you are right…
#Annalie.face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: See you later!
You: Bye!
